_comment: Pterodactyl Minecraft Multi-Profile Manager v2.1. Docker image label fixed for current Pterodactyl validation.
name: Minecraft Multi-Profile Manager v2.1
author: local@example.com
description: Store many Minecraft servers under /home/container/servers and run exactly one at a time on a single Pterodactyl allocation. Includes profile.conf overrides, server-type detection, automatic Java runtime selection/caching, profile validation, and per-profile switch backups.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu

ROOT="/mnt/server"
PROFILE_ROOT="${ROOT}/servers"
DEFAULT_DIR="${PROFILE_ROOT}/default"
USER_AGENT="Pterodactyl-Multi-Profile/2.0 (local-server-manager)"

mkdir -p "$DEFAULT_DIR" "${ROOT}/profile-backups" "${ROOT}/.multi-profile-state" "${ROOT}/.multijava"

cat > "${ROOT}/profile-launcher.sh" <<'MULTI_LAUNCHER'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Pterodactyl Minecraft Multi-Profile Manager v2
# One Pterodactyl server + one allocation, many stored Minecraft profiles.

CONTAINER_ROOT="${CONTAINER_ROOT:-/home/container}"
PROFILE_ROOT="${PROFILE_ROOT:-${CONTAINER_ROOT}/servers}"
BACKUP_ROOT="${BACKUP_ROOT:-${CONTAINER_ROOT}/profile-backups}"
JAVA_ROOT="${JAVA_ROOT:-${CONTAINER_ROOT}/.multijava}"
STATE_ROOT="${STATE_ROOT:-${CONTAINER_ROOT}/.multi-profile-state}"

PROFILE="${SERVER_PROFILE:-default}"
GLOBAL_BACKUP_ON_SWITCH="${AUTO_BACKUP_ON_SWITCH:-true}"
GLOBAL_BACKUP_KEEP="${BACKUP_KEEP:-5}"
ACCEPT_EULA_VALUE="${ACCEPT_EULA:-false}"

log()  { printf '%s\n' "[Multi-Profile] $*"; }
warn() { printf '%s\n' "[Multi-Profile] WARNING: $*" >&2; }
die()  { printf '%s\n' "[Multi-Profile] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

is_true() {
    case "${1:-false}" in
        1|true|TRUE|yes|YES|on|ON) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

valid_profile_name() {
    name="${1:-}"
    [ -n "$name" ] || return 1
    case "$name" in
        *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|*..*|.|..|/*|*/*|*\\*) return 1 ;;
        *) return 0 ;;
    esac
}

list_profiles() {
    if [ ! -d "$PROFILE_ROOT" ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    for d in "$PROFILE_ROOT"/*; do
        [ -d "$d" ] || continue
        basename "$d"
    done | sort
}

trim_value() {
    # Removes CR and one matching pair of simple quotes.
    value="$(printf '%s' "$1" | tr -d '\r')"
    case "$value" in
        \"*\") value="${value#\"}"; value="${value%\"}" ;;
        \'*\') value="${value#\'}"; value="${value%\'}" ;;
    esac
    printf '%s' "$value"
}

# Per-profile defaults. Startup is intentionally minimal; profile.conf is the main config.
reset_profile_config() {
    PROFILE_NAME="$PROFILE"
    CFG_SERVER_TYPE="auto"
    CFG_MINECRAFT_VERSION="auto"
    CFG_JAVA_VERSION="auto"
    CFG_LAUNCH_MODE="auto"
    CFG_SERVER_JAR="auto"
    CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT="run.sh"
    CFG_JAVA_ARGS=""
    CFG_XMS_MB="128"
    CFG_MEMORY_PERCENT="95"
    CFG_BACKUP_ON_SWITCH="$GLOBAL_BACKUP_ON_SWITCH"
    CFG_BACKUP_KEEP="$GLOBAL_BACKUP_KEEP"
    CFG_BACKUP_EXCLUDE_LOGS="true"
}

load_profile_config() {
    dir="$1"
    reset_profile_config
    cfg="$dir/profile.conf"

    if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
        log "No profile.conf found; using automatic detection defaults."
        return 0
    fi

    while IFS= read -r raw || [ -n "$raw" ]; do
        line="$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr -d '\r')"
        case "$line" in
            ''|\#*) continue ;;
            *=*) ;;
            *) warn "Ignoring malformed profile.conf line: $line"; continue ;;
        esac

        key="${line%%=*}"
        value="${line#*=}"
        value="$(trim_value "$value")"

        case "$key" in
            NAME) PROFILE_NAME="$value" ;;
            SERVER_TYPE) CFG_SERVER_TYPE="$value" ;;
            MINECRAFT_VERSION) CFG_MINECRAFT_VERSION="$value" ;;
            JAVA_VERSION) CFG_JAVA_VERSION="$value" ;;
            LAUNCH_MODE) CFG_LAUNCH_MODE="$value" ;;
            SERVER_JAR) CFG_SERVER_JAR="$value" ;;
            SERVER_SCRIPT) CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT="$value" ;;
            JAVA_ARGS) CFG_JAVA_ARGS="$value" ;;
            XMS_MB) CFG_XMS_MB="$value" ;;
            MEMORY_PERCENT) CFG_MEMORY_PERCENT="$value" ;;
            BACKUP_ON_SWITCH) CFG_BACKUP_ON_SWITCH="$value" ;;
            BACKUP_KEEP) CFG_BACKUP_KEEP="$value" ;;
            BACKUP_EXCLUDE_LOGS) CFG_BACKUP_EXCLUDE_LOGS="$value" ;;
            *) warn "Unknown profile.conf key ignored: $key" ;;
        esac
    done < "$cfg"
}

validate_profile_config() {
    case "$CFG_SERVER_TYPE" in
        auto|paper|purpur|folia|spigot|vanilla|fabric|quilt|forge|neoforge|mohist|magma|arclight|generic) ;;
        *) die "Invalid SERVER_TYPE '$CFG_SERVER_TYPE' in profile.conf." ;;
    esac

    case "$CFG_JAVA_VERSION" in
        auto|8|11|16|17|21|25) ;;
        *) die "Invalid JAVA_VERSION '$CFG_JAVA_VERSION'. Allowed: auto, 8, 11, 16, 17, 21, 25." ;;
    esac

    case "$CFG_LAUNCH_MODE" in
        auto|jar|script) ;;
        *) die "Invalid LAUNCH_MODE '$CFG_LAUNCH_MODE'. Allowed: auto, jar, script." ;;
    esac

    case "$CFG_MEMORY_PERCENT" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) die "MEMORY_PERCENT must be an integer from 10 to 100." ;;
    esac
    [ "$CFG_MEMORY_PERCENT" -ge 10 ] && [ "$CFG_MEMORY_PERCENT" -le 100 ] \
        || die "MEMORY_PERCENT must be from 10 to 100."

    case "$CFG_XMS_MB" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) die "XMS_MB must be a non-negative integer." ;;
    esac

    case "$CFG_BACKUP_KEEP" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) die "BACKUP_KEEP must be an integer." ;;
    esac
}

write_default_profile_config_if_missing() {
    dir="$1"
    cfg="$dir/profile.conf"
    [ -f "$cfg" ] && return 0
    cat > "$cfg" <<'EOF'
# Minecraft Multi-Profile configuration
# "auto" lets the manager detect what it can.
NAME=Unnamed Profile
SERVER_TYPE=auto
MINECRAFT_VERSION=auto
JAVA_VERSION=auto
LAUNCH_MODE=auto
SERVER_JAR=auto
SERVER_SCRIPT=run.sh
JAVA_ARGS=
XMS_MB=128
MEMORY_PERCENT=95
BACKUP_ON_SWITCH=true
BACKUP_KEEP=5
BACKUP_EXCLUDE_LOGS=true
EOF
    log "Created default profile.conf in $(basename "$dir")."
}

set_property() {
    key="$1"
    value="$2"
    file="$3"
    [ -f "$file" ] || : > "$file"

    if grep -qE "^${key}=" "$file" 2>/dev/null; then
        sed -i "s|^${key}=.*|${key}=${value}|" "$file"
    else
        printf '%s=%s\n' "$key" "$value" >> "$file"
    fi
}

first_match() {
    # Returns the first existing regular file matching one or more shell glob patterns.
    for pattern in "$@"; do
        for f in $pattern; do
            [ -f "$f" ] || continue
            printf '%s\n' "$f"
            return 0
        done
    done
    return 1
}

count_root_jars() {
    count=0
    for f in ./*.jar; do
        [ -f "$f" ] || continue
        count=$((count + 1))
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$count"
}

detect_server_type() {
    if [ "$CFG_SERVER_TYPE" != "auto" ]; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="$CFG_SERVER_TYPE"
        return 0
    fi

    if [ -f "${CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT:-run.sh}" ]; then
        if [ -d libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge ]; then
            DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="neoforge"; return 0
        fi
        if [ -d libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge ]; then
            DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="forge"; return 0
        fi
    fi

    if first_match "./fabric-server-launch.jar" "./fabric-server-mc*.jar" "./fabric-server*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="fabric"; return 0
    fi
    if first_match "./quilt-server-launch.jar" "./quilt-server*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="quilt"; return 0
    fi
    if first_match "./purpur*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="purpur"; return 0; fi
    if first_match "./folia*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="folia"; return 0; fi
    if first_match "./paper*.jar" "./paperclip*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="paper"; return 0; fi
    if first_match "./spigot*.jar" "./craftbukkit*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="spigot"; return 0; fi
    if first_match "./mohist*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="mohist"; return 0; fi
    if first_match "./magma*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="magma"; return 0; fi
    if first_match "./arclight*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="arclight"; return 0; fi

    if [ -d libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge ] || first_match "./forge-*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="forge"; return 0
    fi
    if [ -d libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge ] || first_match "./neoforge-*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="neoforge"; return 0
    fi

    if first_match "./minecraft_server*.jar" "./minecraft-server*.jar" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="vanilla"; return 0
    fi

    if [ -f ./server.jar ]; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="generic"; return 0
    fi

    jars="$(count_root_jars)"
    if [ "$jars" -eq 1 ]; then
        DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE="generic"; return 0
    fi

    die "Could not safely detect a runnable server type. Add SERVER_TYPE and SERVER_JAR/SERVER_SCRIPT to profile.conf."
}

select_server_jar() {
    if [ "$CFG_SERVER_JAR" != "auto" ]; then
        [ -f "$CFG_SERVER_JAR" ] || die "Configured SERVER_JAR not found: $CFG_SERVER_JAR"
        DETECTED_SERVER_JAR="$CFG_SERVER_JAR"
        return 0
    fi

    # Type-specific candidates. We intentionally fail on ambiguous candidates rather than
    # silently launching the wrong jar.
    case "$DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE" in
        paper) patterns="./paper*.jar ./paperclip*.jar" ;;
        purpur) patterns="./purpur*.jar" ;;
        folia) patterns="./folia*.jar" ;;
        spigot) patterns="./spigot*.jar ./craftbukkit*.jar" ;;
        fabric) patterns="./fabric-server-launch.jar ./fabric-server-mc*.jar ./fabric-server*.jar" ;;
        quilt) patterns="./quilt-server-launch.jar ./quilt-server*.jar" ;;
        forge) patterns="./forge-*.jar" ;;
        neoforge) patterns="./neoforge-*.jar" ;;
        mohist) patterns="./mohist*.jar" ;;
        magma) patterns="./magma*.jar" ;;
        arclight) patterns="./arclight*.jar" ;;
        vanilla) patterns="./minecraft_server*.jar ./minecraft-server*.jar ./server.jar" ;;
        generic) patterns="./server.jar" ;;
        *) patterns="" ;;
    esac

    candidates=""
    count=0
    for pattern in $patterns; do
        for f in $pattern; do
            [ -f "$f" ] || continue
            case " $candidates " in *" $f "*) continue ;; esac
            candidates="${candidates}${f}
"
            count=$((count + 1))
        done
    done

    if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
        # If there is exactly one root jar, it is a safe fallback.
        root_count="$(count_root_jars)"
        if [ "$root_count" -eq 1 ]; then
            for f in ./*.jar; do
                [ -f "$f" ] || continue
                DETECTED_SERVER_JAR="${f#./}"
                return 0
            done
        fi
        die "No runnable server jar was found. Set SERVER_JAR in profile.conf."
    fi

    if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then
        warn "Multiple possible server jars were found:"
        printf '%s' "$candidates" | sed '/^$/d' | sed 's/^/[Multi-Profile]   - /' >&2
        die "Refusing to guess. Set SERVER_JAR=<filename> in profile.conf."
    fi

    DETECTED_SERVER_JAR="$(printf '%s' "$candidates" | sed '/^$/d' | head -n 1)"
    DETECTED_SERVER_JAR="${DETECTED_SERVER_JAR#./}"
}

detect_launch_mode() {
    if [ "$CFG_LAUNCH_MODE" != "auto" ]; then
        DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE="$CFG_LAUNCH_MODE"
    else
        case "$DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE" in
            forge|neoforge)
                if [ -f "$CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT" ]; then
                    DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE="script"
                else
                    DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE="jar"
                fi
                ;;
            *)
                DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE="jar"
                ;;
        esac
    fi

    if [ "$DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE" = "script" ]; then
        [ -f "$CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT" ] || die "Startup script not found: $CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT"
        DETECTED_SERVER_JAR=""
    else
        select_server_jar
    fi
}

extract_version_from_text() {
    text="$1"
    # Prefer the new year-based scheme (26.1+) or normal 1.x.y versions.
    printf '%s\n' "$text" \
        | grep -Eo '(^|[^0-9])((2[6-9]|[3-9][0-9])\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?|1\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)([^0-9]|$)' \
        | sed -E 's/^[^0-9]*//; s/[^0-9.].*$//' \
        | head -n 1 || true
}

detect_version_from_logs() {
    [ -f logs/latest.log ] || return 1

    v="$(grep -Eo '\(MC: [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){1,2}\)' logs/latest.log 2>/dev/null \
        | tail -n 1 | sed 's/(MC: //;s/)//' || true)"
    [ -n "$v" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$v"; return 0; }

    v="$(grep -Eo 'Starting minecraft server version [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){1,2}' logs/latest.log 2>/dev/null \
        | tail -n 1 | awk '{print $NF}' || true)"
    [ -n "$v" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$v"; return 0; }

    v="$(grep -Eo 'Loading Minecraft [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){1,2}' logs/latest.log 2>/dev/null \
        | tail -n 1 | awk '{print $NF}' || true)"
    [ -n "$v" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$v"; return 0; }

    return 1
}

detect_version_from_libraries() {
    # Forge library directories are normally <minecraft>-<forge>.
    if [ -d libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge ]; then
        for d in libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/*; do
            [ -d "$d" ] || continue
            base="$(basename "$d")"
            v="$(extract_version_from_text "$base")"
            [ -n "$v" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$v"; return 0; }
        done
    fi

    # Fabric/Quilt intermediary directory is the Minecraft version.
    if [ -d libraries/net/fabricmc/intermediary ]; then
        for d in libraries/net/fabricmc/intermediary/*; do
            [ -d "$d" ] || continue
            base="$(basename "$d")"
            v="$(extract_version_from_text "$base")"
            [ -n "$v" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$v"; return 0; }
        done
    fi

    # NeoForge versions before the 26.x scheme commonly use 21.1.x => MC 1.21.1.
    if [ -d libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge ]; then
        for d in libraries/net/neoforged/neoforge/*; do
            [ -d "$d" ] || continue
            base="$(basename "$d")"
            major="$(printf '%s' "$base" | cut -d. -f1)"
            minor="$(printf '%s' "$base" | cut -d. -f2)"
            case "$major:$minor" in
                *[!0-9:]*|:*) continue ;;
            esac
            if [ "$major" -ge 26 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                printf '%s.%s\n' "$major" "$minor"; return 0
            elif [ "$major" -ge 20 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                printf '1.%s.%s\n' "$major" "$minor"; return 0
            fi
        done
    fi
    return 1
}

detect_version_from_jar_metadata() {
    jar="$1"
    [ -n "$jar" ] && [ -f "$jar" ] || return 1
    command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1

    # Vanilla and some server wrappers include version.json.
    content="$(unzip -p "$jar" version.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 8192 || true)"
    [ -n "$content" ] || return 1

    v="$(printf '%s' "$content" \
        | grep -Eo '"id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"' \
        | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)"$/\1/' || true)"
    v="$(extract_version_from_text "$v")"
    [ -n "$v" ] && { printf '%s\n' "$v"; return 0; }
    return 1
}

detect_minecraft_version() {
    if [ "$CFG_MINECRAFT_VERSION" != "auto" ] && [ -n "$CFG_MINECRAFT_VERSION" ]; then
        DETECTED_MINECRAFT_VERSION="$CFG_MINECRAFT_VERSION"
        return 0
    fi

    v=""
    if [ -n "${DETECTED_SERVER_JAR:-}" ]; then
        v="$(extract_version_from_text "$DETECTED_SERVER_JAR")"
    fi
    [ -n "$v" ] || v="$(detect_version_from_libraries || true)"
    [ -n "$v" ] || v="$(detect_version_from_logs || true)"
    if [ -z "$v" ] && [ -n "${DETECTED_SERVER_JAR:-}" ]; then
        v="$(detect_version_from_jar_metadata "$DETECTED_SERVER_JAR" || true)"
    fi

    if [ -z "$v" ]; then
        DETECTED_MINECRAFT_VERSION="unknown"
    else
        DETECTED_MINECRAFT_VERSION="$v"
    fi
}

java_for_minecraft_version() {
    version="$1"
    stype="$2"

    case "$version" in
        2[6-9].*|[3-9][0-9].*) printf '25\n'; return 0 ;;
        1.*) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac

    minor="$(printf '%s' "$version" | cut -d. -f2)"
    patch="$(printf '%s' "$version" | cut -d. -f3)"
    [ -n "$patch" ] || patch=0

    case "$minor:$patch" in
        *[!0-9:]*|:*) return 1 ;;
    esac

    # Paper-family mapping follows PaperMC's current recommendations.
    case "$stype" in
        paper|purpur|folia)
            if [ "$minor" -le 11 ]; then printf '8\n'
            elif [ "$minor" -le 15 ]; then printf '11\n'
            elif [ "$minor" -eq 16 ] && [ "$patch" -le 4 ]; then printf '11\n'
            elif [ "$minor" -eq 16 ]; then printf '16\n'
            elif [ "$minor" -le 19 ]; then printf '17\n'
            else printf '21\n'
            fi
            return 0
            ;;
    esac

    # Vanilla / Fabric / Forge / NeoForge / generic historical baseline.
    if [ "$minor" -le 16 ]; then
        printf '8\n'
    elif [ "$minor" -eq 17 ]; then
        printf '16\n'
    elif [ "$minor" -le 19 ]; then
        printf '17\n'
    elif [ "$minor" -eq 20 ]; then
        if [ "$patch" -ge 5 ]; then printf '21\n'; else printf '17\n'; fi
    else
        printf '21\n'
    fi
}

select_java_version() {
    if [ "$CFG_JAVA_VERSION" != "auto" ]; then
        SELECTED_JAVA_VERSION="$CFG_JAVA_VERSION"
        return 0
    fi

    if [ "$DETECTED_MINECRAFT_VERSION" = "unknown" ]; then
        die "Minecraft version could not be detected, so Java cannot be selected safely. Set MINECRAFT_VERSION or JAVA_VERSION in profile.conf."
    fi

    SELECTED_JAVA_VERSION="$(java_for_minecraft_version "$DETECTED_MINECRAFT_VERSION" "$DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE" || true)"
    [ -n "$SELECTED_JAVA_VERSION" ] \
        || die "No automatic Java rule for Minecraft '$DETECTED_MINECRAFT_VERSION'. Set JAVA_VERSION in profile.conf."
}

detect_arch() {
    case "$(uname -m)" in
        x86_64|amd64) printf 'x64\n' ;;
        aarch64|arm64) printf 'aarch64\n' ;;
        armv7l|armv7) printf 'arm\n' ;;
        *) die "Unsupported CPU architecture for automatic Java download: $(uname -m)" ;;
    esac
}

ensure_java() {
    version="$1"
    target="${JAVA_ROOT}/temurin-${version}"

    if [ -x "${target}/bin/java" ]; then
        JAVA_BIN="${target}/bin/java"
        JAVA_HOME_SELECTED="$target"
        return 0
    fi

    # If the container's built-in Java already matches, use it without downloading.
    if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        current="$(java -version 2>&1 | head -n 1 | sed -E 's/.*version "([0-9]+).*/\1/' || true)"
        if [ "$current" = "1.8.0_OLD" ]; then current=8; fi
        # Old Java 8 reports "1.8".
        case "$(java -version 2>&1 | head -n 1)" in
            *'"1.8.'*) current=8 ;;
        esac
        if [ "$current" = "$version" ]; then
            JAVA_BIN="$(command -v java)"
            JAVA_HOME_SELECTED="$(dirname "$(dirname "$JAVA_BIN")")"
            return 0
        fi
    fi

    command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "curl is required to download Java automatically."
    command -v tar >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "tar is required to install Java automatically."

    arch="$(detect_arch)"
    os_name="linux"
    api="https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/${version}/ga/${os_name}/${arch}/jre/hotspot/normal/eclipse"

    mkdir -p "$JAVA_ROOT"
    tmp="${JAVA_ROOT}/.install-java-${version}-$$"
    archive="${tmp}.tar.gz"
    rm -rf "$tmp" "$archive"
    mkdir -p "$tmp"

    log "Java ${version} is not cached. Downloading Eclipse Temurin JRE (${arch})..."
    if ! curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 \
        -A "Pterodactyl-Multi-Profile/2.0 (local-server-manager)" \
        -o "$archive" "$api"; then
        rm -rf "$tmp" "$archive"
        die "Failed to download Java ${version} from Adoptium."
    fi

    if ! tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$tmp"; then
        rm -rf "$tmp" "$archive"
        die "Failed to extract Java ${version}."
    fi

    found="$(find "$tmp" -type f -path '*/bin/java' | head -n 1 || true)"
    [ -n "$found" ] || { rm -rf "$tmp" "$archive"; die "Downloaded Java archive did not contain bin/java."; }

    home="$(dirname "$(dirname "$found")")"
    rm -rf "$target"
    mv "$home" "$target"
    rm -rf "$tmp" "$archive"

    [ -x "${target}/bin/java" ] || die "Java ${version} installation finished but bin/java is missing."
    JAVA_BIN="${target}/bin/java"
    JAVA_HOME_SELECTED="$target"
}

backup_profile() {
    profile="$1"
    reason="${2:-manual}"

    valid_profile_name "$profile" || { warn "Skipping backup for invalid profile name '$profile'."; return 0; }
    src="${PROFILE_ROOT}/${profile}"
    [ -d "$src" ] || { warn "Skipping backup; profile no longer exists: $profile"; return 0; }

    # Load only backup-related values from that profile without disturbing active config.
    keep="$GLOBAL_BACKUP_KEEP"
    enabled="$GLOBAL_BACKUP_ON_SWITCH"
    exclude_logs="true"
    cfg="$src/profile.conf"
    if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then
        while IFS= read -r raw || [ -n "$raw" ]; do
            line="$(printf '%s' "$raw" | tr -d '\r')"
            case "$line" in
                BACKUP_ON_SWITCH=*) enabled="$(trim_value "${line#*=}")" ;;
                BACKUP_KEEP=*) keep="$(trim_value "${line#*=}")" ;;
                BACKUP_EXCLUDE_LOGS=*) exclude_logs="$(trim_value "${line#*=}")" ;;
            esac
        done < "$cfg"
    fi

    is_true "$enabled" || { log "Backup-on-switch disabled for '$profile'."; return 0; }

    case "$keep" in ''|*[!0-9]*) keep=5 ;; esac

    dest="${BACKUP_ROOT}/${profile}"
    mkdir -p "$dest"
    stamp="$(date '+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')-$$"
    out="${dest}/${profile}-${stamp}-${reason}.tar.gz"

    log "Backing up previous profile '$profile' -> $out"
    if is_true "$exclude_logs"; then
        if ! tar -czf "$out" -C "$src" \
            --exclude='./logs' --exclude='./cache' --exclude='./crash-reports' .; then
            rm -f "$out"
            die "Profile backup failed for '$profile'. Refusing to start the next profile."
        fi
    else
        if ! tar -czf "$out" -C "$src" .; then
            rm -f "$out"
            die "Profile backup failed for '$profile'. Refusing to start the next profile."
        fi
    fi

    if [ "$keep" -eq 0 ]; then
        return 0
    fi

    # Keep newest N backups for this profile.
    idx=0
    for f in $(ls -1t "$dest"/*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null || true); do
        idx=$((idx + 1))
        if [ "$idx" -gt "$keep" ]; then
            rm -f "$f"
        fi
    done
}

handle_profile_switch_backup() {
    mkdir -p "$STATE_ROOT"
    state_file="${STATE_ROOT}/last_profile"
    previous=""
    [ -f "$state_file" ] && previous="$(cat "$state_file" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r\n' || true)"

    if [ -n "$previous" ] && [ "$previous" != "$PROFILE" ]; then
        log "Profile switch detected: $previous -> $PROFILE"
        backup_profile "$previous" "switch"
    fi
}

save_active_profile_state() {
    mkdir -p "$STATE_ROOT"
    printf '%s\n' "$PROFILE" > "${STATE_ROOT}/last_profile"
}

# ---- Startup ----

valid_profile_name "$PROFILE" || {
    printf '%s\n' "[Multi-Profile] Invalid SERVER_PROFILE '$PROFILE'." >&2
    printf '%s\n' "[Multi-Profile] Allowed: letters, numbers, dot, underscore, hyphen. No paths." >&2
    exit 1
}

PROFILE_DIR="${PROFILE_ROOT}/${PROFILE}"
if [ ! -d "$PROFILE_DIR" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "[Multi-Profile] ERROR: Profile '$PROFILE' does not exist." >&2
    printf '%s\n' "[Multi-Profile] Available profiles:" >&2
    list_profiles | sed 's/^/[Multi-Profile]   - /' >&2
    exit 1
fi

write_default_profile_config_if_missing "$PROFILE_DIR"
load_profile_config "$PROFILE_DIR"
validate_profile_config

cd "$PROFILE_DIR"

detect_server_type
detect_launch_mode
detect_minecraft_version
select_java_version

# Back up the previously stopped profile only after the new target has passed validation.
handle_profile_switch_backup

# Pterodactyl primary allocation always wins over profile-local port settings.
set_property "server-ip" "0.0.0.0" "server.properties"
set_property "server-port" "${SERVER_PORT}" "server.properties"
set_property "query.port" "${SERVER_PORT}" "server.properties"

if is_true "$ACCEPT_EULA_VALUE"; then
    printf 'eula=true\n' > eula.txt
fi

server_mem="${SERVER_MEMORY:-1024}"
case "$server_mem" in ''|*[!0-9]*) server_mem=1024 ;; esac
xmx_mb=$((server_mem * CFG_MEMORY_PERCENT / 100))
[ "$xmx_mb" -ge 128 ] || xmx_mb=128

printf '%s\n' "============================================================"
log "Profile          : $PROFILE (${PROFILE_NAME})"
log "Server type      : $DETECTED_SERVER_TYPE"
log "Minecraft version: $DETECTED_MINECRAFT_VERSION"
log "Java             : $SELECTED_JAVA_VERSION"
log "Launch mode      : $DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE"
if [ "$DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE" = "jar" ]; then
    log "Server jar       : $DETECTED_SERVER_JAR"
else
    log "Server script    : $CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT"
fi
log "Primary port     : ${SERVER_PORT}"
log "Memory           : Xms=${CFG_XMS_MB}M / Xmx=${xmx_mb}M (${CFG_MEMORY_PERCENT}% of allocation)"
printf '%s\n' "============================================================"

# Useful for package tests and manual diagnostics; not exposed as an Egg variable.
if is_true "${MULTI_DRY_RUN:-false}"; then
    log "Dry-run enabled; Java download and server execution skipped."
    save_active_profile_state
    exit 0
fi

ensure_java "$SELECTED_JAVA_VERSION"
export JAVA_HOME="$JAVA_HOME_SELECTED"
export PATH="${JAVA_HOME_SELECTED}/bin:${PATH}"

log "Using Java binary: $JAVA_BIN"
"$JAVA_BIN" -version

# Save only after all validation + Java provisioning has succeeded.
save_active_profile_state

if [ "$DETECTED_LAUNCH_MODE" = "script" ]; then
    chmod +x "$CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT" 2>/dev/null || true
    # Forge/NeoForge run.sh uses "java"; PATH/JAVA_HOME above force the selected runtime.
    exec sh "./$CFG_SERVER_SCRIPT" nogui
fi

# JAVA_ARGS is intentionally word-split to support normal JVM flag strings in profile.conf.
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
exec "$JAVA_BIN" \
    -Xms"${CFG_XMS_MB}"M \
    -Xmx"${xmx_mb}"M \
    ${CFG_JAVA_ARGS} \
    -Dterminal.jline=false \
    -Dterminal.ansi=true \
    -jar "$DETECTED_SERVER_JAR" nogui
MULTI_LAUNCHER
chmod +x "${ROOT}/profile-launcher.sh"

cat > "${ROOT}/profile-backup.sh" <<'MULTI_BACKUP'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

# Manual helper for shell/SFTP administrators.
# Usage: ./profile-backup.sh <profile>

CONTAINER_ROOT="${CONTAINER_ROOT:-/home/container}"
PROFILE_ROOT="${PROFILE_ROOT:-${CONTAINER_ROOT}/servers}"
BACKUP_ROOT="${BACKUP_ROOT:-${CONTAINER_ROOT}/profile-backups}"
PROFILE="${1:-}"

case "$PROFILE" in
    ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|*..*|.|..|/*|*/*|*\\*)
        echo "Usage: $0 <profile>" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

src="${PROFILE_ROOT}/${PROFILE}"
[ -d "$src" ] || { echo "Profile not found: $PROFILE" >&2; exit 1; }

dest="${BACKUP_ROOT}/${PROFILE}"
mkdir -p "$dest"
stamp="$(date '+%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')-$$"
out="${dest}/${PROFILE}-${stamp}-manual.tar.gz"

echo "Creating $out"
tar -czf "$out" -C "$src" --exclude='./logs' --exclude='./cache' --exclude='./crash-reports' .
echo "Done."
MULTI_BACKUP
chmod +x "${ROOT}/profile-backup.sh"

cat > "${ROOT}/profile.conf.example" <<'PROFILE_EXAMPLE'
# profile.conf
# Put one copy in each /home/container/servers/<profile>/ directory.
#
# Normally you can leave most values as "auto".
# If automatic version detection cannot determine an old renamed server.jar,
# set MINECRAFT_VERSION manually once (for example 1.12.2).

NAME=My Minecraft Server

# auto, paper, purpur, folia, spigot, vanilla, fabric, quilt,
# forge, neoforge, mohist, magma, arclight, generic
SERVER_TYPE=auto

# auto or an exact Minecraft version such as 1.12.2, 1.20.1, 1.21.11, 26.1
MINECRAFT_VERSION=auto

# auto, 8, 11, 16, 17, 21, 25
JAVA_VERSION=auto

# auto, jar, script
LAUNCH_MODE=auto

# auto or an exact root-level jar name
SERVER_JAR=auto

# Used for Forge/NeoForge script mode
SERVER_SCRIPT=run.sh

# Optional additional JVM flags
JAVA_ARGS=

# Memory settings within the Pterodactyl server memory allocation
XMS_MB=128
MEMORY_PERCENT=95

# When switching away from this profile, create a profile-only tar.gz backup
BACKUP_ON_SWITCH=true
BACKUP_KEEP=5
BACKUP_EXCLUDE_LOGS=true
PROFILE_EXAMPLE

# Preserve an existing default profile if the server is being reinstalled.
if [ ! -f "${DEFAULT_DIR}/profile.conf" ]; then
    cat > "${DEFAULT_DIR}/profile.conf" <<'DEFAULT_PROFILE'
NAME=Default Paper
SERVER_TYPE=paper
MINECRAFT_VERSION=auto
JAVA_VERSION=auto
LAUNCH_MODE=jar
SERVER_JAR=server.jar
SERVER_SCRIPT=run.sh
JAVA_ARGS=
XMS_MB=128
MEMORY_PERCENT=95
BACKUP_ON_SWITCH=true
BACKUP_KEEP=5
BACKUP_EXCLUDE_LOGS=true
DEFAULT_PROFILE
fi

# Install a default Paper server only when the profile has no server jar.
if ! find "$DEFAULT_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.jar' | grep -q .; then
    PROJECT="paper"

    if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL="${DL_PATH}"
        FOUND_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-custom}"
    else
        PROJECT_META="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" \
            "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}")"

        if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
            # The Paper API returns version groups newest-first; preserve that order.
            VERSIONS="$(echo "$PROJECT_META" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries[] | .value[]')"
        else
            VERSIONS="${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
        fi

        DOWNLOAD_URL=""
        FOUND_VERSION=""
        for VERSION in $VERSIONS; do
            BUILDS="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" \
                "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${VERSION}/builds" || true)"
            [ -n "$BUILDS" ] || continue
            URL="$(echo "$BUILDS" | jq -r 'first(.[] | select(.channel == "STABLE") | .downloads."server:default".url) // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)"
            if [ -n "$URL" ]; then
                DOWNLOAD_URL="$URL"
                FOUND_VERSION="$VERSION"
                break
            fi
        done

        [ -n "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ] || {
            echo "[Installer] Could not find a stable Paper build." >&2
            exit 1
        }
    fi

    echo "[Installer] Installing Paper ${FOUND_VERSION} into servers/default"
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" \
        -o "${DEFAULT_DIR}/server.jar" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"

    # Persist the known version so Java selection does not need to guess.
    if [ "$FOUND_VERSION" != "custom" ] && [ -n "$FOUND_VERSION" ]; then
        sed -i "s/^MINECRAFT_VERSION=.*/MINECRAFT_VERSION=${FOUND_VERSION}/" "${DEFAULT_DIR}/profile.conf"
    fi
fi

if [ ! -f "${DEFAULT_DIR}/server.properties" ]; then
    cat > "${DEFAULT_DIR}/server.properties" <<'PROPERTIES'
server-ip=0.0.0.0
server-port=25565
query.port=25565
motd=Pterodactyl Multi-Profile Minecraft Server
enable-query=false
PROPERTIES
fi

echo "[Installer] Multi-Profile Manager v2 installed."
echo "[Installer] Default profile: /home/container/servers/default"
echo "[Installer] Change only SERVER_PROFILE in Startup to switch profiles."

variables.description: Set true only if you accept the Minecraft EULA. Applied to the selected profile.

variables.description: Global fallback. Individual profile.conf files can override BACKUP_ON_SWITCH.

variables.name: Backup Retention
variables.description: Default number of backups kept per profile. profile.conf can override BACKUP_KEEP.

variables.name: Initial Paper Version
variables.description: Used only when the Egg installer creates servers/default. Use latest or an exact version.

variables.description: Optional admin-only jar URL for initial servers/default creation.
